name: Beaver County, PA
findings: Beaver County has 582 nonprofit organizations. 268 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 212 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Beaver County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 33 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 health care organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 7 professional organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
